# pbs_network_interface (Data Source)

Reads one network interface of a Proxmox Backup Server node, with the attributes `pbs_network_interfaces` lists: an interface of `/etc/network/interfaces`, the loopback interface `lo`, or a physical NIC the file does not name, which PBS reports as type `eth`, method `manual`, without autostart. PBS looks the interface up by that name, not by an alternative name, and cannot read an alias such as `eth0:1` on its own; `pbs_network_interfaces` lists it. To manage an interface, use `pbs_network_interface`.

Needs `Sys.Audit on /system/network/interfaces/<name>`, which an ACL entry on `/system/network/interfaces` grants too when it propagates; `pbs_network_interfaces` needs `Sys.Audit on /system/network/interfaces`.

~> **Pending changes.** While `/etc/network/interfaces.new` holds changes made through the API or the web interface and not applied yet, PBS reads the interface from it, so the data source shows its pending configuration, not the one the node runs; `pending_changes` of `pbs_network_interfaces` shows the difference. A bridge, bond, VLAN or other virtual interface removed only there reads as missing, although the node runs it until the change is applied. A physical NIC whose stanza was removed reads as one the file does not name — type `eth`, method `manual`, without autostart —, and `lo` as PBS adds it itself, with autostart. Reading one interface does not compare the two files, so it works where the list fails with `diff failed`, as when `/etc/network/interfaces` is missing.

~> PBS releases before 4.2.7 cannot parse the method `auto`: a stanza such as `iface eth0 inet6 auto` makes reading fail with `unknown iface option auto`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_network_interface" "management" {
  name = "vmbr0"
}

# The node's management address, without its prefix length.
output "pbs_address" {
  value = try(split("/", data.pbs_network_interface.management.cidr)[0], null)
}

# Warn when the management bridge has lost its uplink.
check "pbs_management_bridge_has_ports" {
  assert {
    condition     = length(data.pbs_network_interface.management.bridge_ports) > 0
    error_message = "vmbr0 has no bridge ports."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the interface to read, such as `vmbr0` or `eno1`, as the file or, for a physical NIC the file does not name, `ip link` names it — not an alternative name; `lo` reads the loopback interface, which `pbs_network_interfaces` leaves out.

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the interface is up, as `ip link` reports it; false for an interface of the file the node does not have. Always false for `lo`, which PBS never reports up.
- `altnames` (List of String) Alternative names of the interface, as `ip link` reports them.
- `autostart` (Boolean) Whether the file brings the interface up at boot, with an `auto` line; `allow-hotplug` does not count. True for `lo` when the file has `auto lo` or does not name `lo` at all, as PBS then adds it itself.
- `bond_mode` (String) Mode of a bond: `balance-rr`, `active-backup`, `balance-xor`, `broadcast`, `802.3ad`, `balance-tlb` or `balance-alb`; null when unset.
- `bond_primary` (String) Primary interface of a bond, from its `bond-primary` line; null when unset.
- `bond_xmit_hash_policy` (String) Transmit hash policy of a bond: `layer2`, `layer2+3` or `layer3+4`; null when unset.
- `bridge_ports` (List of String) Ports of a bridge, from its `bridge-ports` line; empty for other interfaces and for `bridge-ports none`.
- `bridge_vlan_aware` (Boolean) Whether a bridge is VLAN-aware, from its `bridge-vlan-aware` line; null without one.
- `cidr` (String) IPv4 address with its prefix length, such as `192.0.2.10/24`; PBS converts an `address` with a `netmask`. Null when unset.
- `cidr6` (String) IPv6 address with its prefix length, such as `2001:db8::10/64`; null when unset.
- `comments` (String) Comment lines of the `inet` stanza, without their `#`, one per line; null without any.
- `comments6` (String) Comment lines of an `inet6` stanza, without their `#`, one per line; null without any.
- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the configuration file PBS read, in hexadecimal — `/etc/network/interfaces.new` while changes are pending, otherwise `/etc/network/interfaces` —, as `pbs_network_interfaces` reports it; it changes whenever the file does.
- `gateway` (String) IPv4 gateway; null when unset.
- `gateway6` (String) IPv6 gateway; null when unset.
- `method` (String) Method of the interface's `inet` (IPv4) stanza: `static`, `dhcp`, `manual`, `loopback` or, from PBS 4.2.7, `auto`; null without one.
- `method6` (String) Method of the interface's `inet6` (IPv6) stanza, one of the same; null without one.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU, in bytes; null when the file does not set one.
- `options` (List of String) Lines of the `inet` stanza PBS does not interpret, such as `post-up` commands, verbatim.
- `options6` (List of String) Lines of an `inet6` stanza PBS does not interpret, verbatim.
- `slaves` (List of String) Interfaces of a bond, from its `bond-slaves` line; empty for other interfaces.
- `type` (String) Type of the interface: `loopback` for `lo`, `eth` for a physical NIC, `bridge`, `bond`, `vlan`, or `unknown` for one PBS cannot place, such as a virtual interface the file names.
- `vlan_id` (Number) VLAN tag of a VLAN interface, from its `vlan-id` line; null without one. PBS does not take it from a name such as `eno1.10`.
- `vlan_raw_device` (String) Interface a VLAN interface runs on, from its `vlan-raw-device` line; null without one.
